prompt: In a photorealistic photo, a bustling pottery workshop is captured in sharp detail. On the left, a woman in a blue apron sits on a wooden stool, her hands covered in wet clay as she shapes a spinning wheel. Next to her, a tall man in a striped shirt points at the emerging vase, guiding her technique. A small brown dog lies on the floor beside the stool, watching the spinning clay with interest. In the center, a large kiln dominates the space, its metal door slightly ajar to reveal glowing embers inside. Standing before it, an older woman in a grey cardigan holds a ceramic mug, checking its temperature with care. To her right, a young boy in a yellow t-shirt looks at the kiln with wide eyes, holding a paintbrush tightly. Behind them, a shelf displays twelve distinct finished pots: a red bowl, a green vase, a white plate, a blue cup, a black jar, a purple urn, an orange dish, a pink figurine, a grey box, a silver tray, a gold statue, and a teal pitcher. Each item rests neatly on the wood, catching the ambient light. Near the back wall, a cat with white fur sleeps on a stack of newspapers, ignoring the activity around it. A teenager in a denim jacket stands next to the cat, sketching the scene in a notebook. On the far right, a man in a green vest carries a heavy sack of clay, walking toward the workbench. A woman in a floral dress stands by the window, looking at the rain outside while holding a towel. A ladder leans against the wall near her, reaching up to the high shelves. A clock hangs above the door, showing the late afternoon hour. A broom rests in the corner, bristles worn from use. There is no electricity visible in the form of wires or plugs. There is no modern technology like phones or computers. There is no text or signage on the walls.
